title: Great Clock!
text: Great Clock!. I use this in my kindergarten classroom.  It's nice and colorful, looks great and works properly.  I'm happy with it🙂

product_metadata.title: WUWEOT Colorful Kid Wall Clock, 12 Inch Round Non Ticking Battery Operated Easy to Read Large 3D Numerals Clock for Children Nursery Room, Home, Classroom, School
features: 12 inch colorful clock. Decorate and enhance your kid’s bedroom, preschoo, elementary, library, baby nursery, toddler playroom, classroom, school, or office.
Special and elegant design meet all your decoration need. Rich colors of the silent wall clock to bring the feeling of youth.
Quiet and precise sweep second hand, no ticking to ensure a good sleeping or working environment and guarantees accurate time. Our clocks runs with one AA battery (not included).
Comes with wide slot in back for easy hanging. Simply press in and will not damage wall.
Premium glass cover to ensure protection from dust and debris. Easy to read large 3D numerals, plastic frame makes it lightweight.
